arcs.name: Opening a Dream 🍲
arcs.intro: Rosie opens her first restaurant in Bellport.

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: I'm almost ready to open my restaurant! I still have so much to do.
episodes.translation: もうすぐ自分のお店がオープンする！まだやることがいっぱい。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: ロージー、きっとできるよ！

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: レストランの開店って何？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: 来てみたらわかるよ！

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: The sign is up! We're opening this Saturday. I'm so nervous!
episodes.translation: 看板がついた！今週土曜日にオープンするよ。すごく緊張する！

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: ランチに行くね！

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.translation: まずコーヒー。それからランチ。

episodes.author: The Chirp Times
episodes.text: LOCAL NEWS: Rosie Pan will open Rosie's Kitchen in Bellport this Saturday. The owner has been preparing for months.
episodes.translation: 地元ニュース：Rosie Panさんの「Rosie’s Kitchen」が今週土曜日、Bellportに開店予定。店主は数か月にわたり準備を進めてきました。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.translation: コーヒーはあるかな？

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: 職場の近くだ！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Yes, we have coffee. And soup!
replies.translation: はい、コーヒーもスープもあります！
replies.easyText: Yes, we have coffee. And soup!

episodes.author: Rosie's Kitchen
episodes.text: WE ARE OPEN! Today we have tomato soup, fresh bread, and a lot of happy nerves.
episodes.translation: オープンしました！今日はトマトスープと焼きたてパン、そしてドキドキがいっぱいです。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: パンがすごくいい匂い！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: ミカ、来てくれてありがとう！

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: スープは飲み物ですか？

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: I tried the new restaurant near my office. Rosie's soup is so good!
episodes.translation: 職場の近くの新しいレストランに行ってきた。Rosieのスープ、すごくおいしい！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: This made my day. Thank you!
replies.translation: 今日いちばんうれしい！ありがとう！
replies.easyText: This made my day. Thank you!

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: 今週末行ってみるよ。

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: I tried making a new pasta dish. I made a huge mess. The kitchen survived.
episodes.translation: 新しいパスタを試作したら、キッチンが大変なことに。なんとか無事でした。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.translation: パスタは無事だった？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: 大部分はね。😂

episodes.author: Rosie's Kitchen
episodes.text: Help us choose our next special: spicy curry or chocolate pancakes?
episodes.translation: 次のおすすめを選んでね。スパイシーカレー、それともチョコレートパンケーキ？

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: 両方じゃダメなの？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Please do not give me ideas!
replies.translation: 余計なアイデアを出さないで！
replies.easyText: Please do not give me ideas!

episodes.author: Rosie Pan
episodes.text: We sold out of soup today! I need a bigger pot.
episodes.translation: 今日はスープが売り切れた！もっと大きな鍋が必要だわ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: うれしい悲鳴だね！

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: そうね！足は反対してるけど。

episodes.author: Bellport Transit
episodes.text: NOTICE: A small delay on the Harbor Line this afternoon. Please allow extra time.
episodes.translation: お知らせ：本日午後、ハーバー線で小規模な遅延が発生しています。時間に余裕を持ってください。

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: My bread delivery is on that train!
replies.translation: パンの配達がその電車なの！
replies.easyText: My bread delivery is on that train!

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: I can help carry some supplies.
replies.translation: 材料運びなら手伝えるよ。
replies.easyText: I can help carry some supplies.

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.translation: 本当に助かる！

episodes.author: Rosie's Kitchen
episodes.text: A little thank-you dinner this Friday! We made it through our first week together.
episodes.translation: 金曜日に小さな感謝のディナーを開きます！みんなのおかげで最初の1週間を乗り切れました。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: サックス持っていってもいい？

replies.author: Rosie Pan
replies.text: Only if you play something cheerful!
replies.translation: 明るい曲を演奏してくれるなら！
replies.easyText: Only if you play something cheerful!

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: I will bring my human disguise.
replies.translation: 人間用の変装を持っていきます。
replies.easyText: I will bring my human disguise.

arcs.name: A Little Apology 🎷
arcs.intro: Jazz Cat tries to repair a friendship.

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: I had a bad argument with a friend. I don't know what to say now.
episodes.translation: 友達とひどい口論をしてしまった。今、何を言えばいいかわからない。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: 少し時間をとって。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.translation: 話したい？

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: I think I was too harsh yesterday. I should say sorry.
episodes.translation: 昨日は言いすぎたと思う。謝らなきゃ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: It's not easy, but you can do it.
replies.translation: 簡単じゃないけど、できるよ。
replies.easyText: It's not easy, but you can do it.

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: ありがとう。でもまだ怖いよ。

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: I finally sent the message. Now I'm waiting.
episodes.translation: ようやくメッセージを送った。今は返事を待ってる。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: 勇気が要ったね。

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.text: Waiting is a strange human sport.
replies.translation: 待つというのは奇妙な人間のスポーツですね。
replies.easyText: Waiting is a strange human sport.

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: We talked. We both made mistakes. I feel a little better.
episodes.translation: 話ができた。お互いに間違いがあった。少し気持ちが楽になった。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: 話せてよかったね。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: 僕もそう思う。ありがとう。

episodes.author: Jazz Cat
episodes.text: My friend and I played music together again. It felt like home.
episodes.translation: 友達とまた一緒に演奏した。帰ってきたような気分だった。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.translation: 音楽は会話の助けになるよね。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.translation: それはいいニュースだ。

episodes.author: Nova Orbit
episodes.text: Today I learned that humans talk about the weather when they have nothing to say.
episodes.translation: 今日は、人間は話題がないときに天気の話をすると学びました。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: It is a friendly way to start.
replies.translation: 親しく話し始める方法なんだよ。
replies.easyText: It is a friendly way to start.

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: では……いい天気ですね？

episodes.author: Nova Orbit
episodes.text: I tried saying “nice weather” during a storm. People looked confused.
episodes.translation: 嵐の日に「いい天気ですね」と言ってみました。みんな困惑していました。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.translation: まず空を見たほうがいいかも。😂

replies.author: Nova Orbit
replies.translation: 記録しました。まず空。

episodes.author: Nova Orbit
episodes.text: I made a new friend today. We talked about clouds for ten minutes.
episodes.translation: 今日は新しい友達ができました。雲について10分間話しました。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.translation: それは素敵だね。

arcs.name: Mika Visits Eastmere 🚆
arcs.intro: Mika travels from Bellport, explores Eastmere, and makes new musical friends.

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: My suitcase is ready. Tomorrow, I leave Bellport for Eastmere!
episodes.translation: スーツケースの準備ができた。明日、ベルポートからイーストミアへ出発！
episodes.easyText:
My bag is ready.
I travel tomorrow.

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: 幸運のマウスピースも持っていって！

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: I am at Bellport Airport. Which gate is mine? The signs are confusing.
episodes.translation: ベルポート空港にいる。私の搭乗口はどこ？案内表示がややこしい。
episodes.easyText:
Where is my gate?
I am lost.

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: Check your ticket. You have time.
replies.translation: チケットを確認して。まだ時間はあるよ。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: I made it to Eastmere! Neonbridge Station is huge. I took the wrong exit twice.
episodes.translation: イーストミアに着いた！ネオンブリッジ駅は巨大。出口を二度も間違えた。
episodes.easyText:
This station is huge!
I am lost again.

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.translation: ようこそ！4番出口を探して。

episodes.author: Chloe Spark
episodes.text: Mika and I found a tiny cafe near the Neonbridge towers. She ordered the largest coffee.
episodes.translation: ミカとネオンブリッジのビル街の小さなカフェへ。彼女は特大コーヒーを注文した。
episodes.easyText:
Mika is here!
We got coffee.

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: The cup is almost as big as my sax case.
replies.translation: カップがサックスケースくらい大きいよ。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: Willow Lane is quiet in the morning. An old shopkeeper waved, and a cat followed me down the street.
episodes.translation: 朝のウィローレーンは静か。古い店の人が手を振ってくれて、猫が通りをついてきた。
episodes.easyText:
Willow Lane is quiet.
A cat followed me.

replies.author: Chloe Spark
replies.translation: あの猫はみんなに挨拶するの。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: Cloverfield has record stores, old games, and a little live house. Lily showed me her favorite street.
episodes.translation: クローバーフィールドにはレコード店、レトロゲーム、小さなライブハウス。リリーがお気に入りの通りを案内してくれた。
episodes.easyText:
I found old records.
Lily knows this street.

replies.author: Lily Pop
replies.text: We should hear a band tonight!
replies.translation: 今夜バンドを聴きに行こうよ！

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: Harmony Street is full of instrument shops! I tried three saxophone mouthpieces and lost track of time.
episodes.translation: ハーモニー・ストリートは楽器店だらけ！サックスのマウスピースを三つ試して、時間を忘れた。
episodes.easyText:
So many instrument shops!
I tried three mouthpieces.

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: There is a wonderful violin shop here too.
replies.translation: ここにはすてきなバイオリン店もあるよ。

episodes.author: Clara Strings
episodes.text: Tonight I am playing at Brookside Concert Hall. Mika came all the way from Bellport to listen.
episodes.translation: 今夜ブルックサイド・コンサートホールで演奏するの。ミカがベルポートから聴きに来てくれた。
episodes.easyText:
My concert is tonight.
Mika is coming.

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: The hall sounds beautiful. Good luck, Clara!
replies.translation: 響きがきれいなホールだね。クララ、頑張って！

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: After the concert, Clara and I walked beside Brookside River. We talked about music and home.
episodes.translation: コンサート後、クララとブルックサイドの川沿いを散歩した。音楽と故郷の話をした。
episodes.easyText:
We walked by the river.
We talked about music.

replies.author: Clara Strings
replies.text: Next time, bring your sax. We can play together.
replies.translation: 次はサックスを持ってきて。一緒に演奏しよう。

episodes.author: Mika Reed
episodes.text: Back in Bellport at last. My suitcase is heavier, my heart is full, and I have new friends in Eastmere.
episodes.translation: ようやくベルポートに帰宅。スーツケースは重くなり、胸はいっぱい。イーストミアに新しい友達ができた。
episodes.easyText:
I am home!
I made new friends.

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.translation: おかえり！話を全部聞かせて。
